notes.title: Bug fixes and Quality of Life Improvements
notes.content:
[b]Bug fixes and Quality of Life Improvements[/b]
[i]Game experience has been improved[/i]

We’re excited to bring you updates that enhance the overall game experience and add more engaging features!

[b]What's New:[/b] [list] [b]More Music Content:[/b] Added additional music to make gameplay more enjoyable and immersive. [b]Enhanced Multiple Answer Games:[/b] You can now click on shapes in games with multiple answer options, providing a more interactive experience. [*][b]New Achievement – "Artists":[/b] Unlocked when using the whiteboard, encouraging creativity and engagement. [/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b] [list] [*][b]Square vs Rectangle Bug:[/b] Resolved an issue in the Geometry game where squares and rectangles were not differentiated correctly. [/list]

Enjoy the updated experience, and thank you for your feedback! Keep playing and watch for more improvements in future updates.

notes.title: Virtual Zoo review
notes.content:
After some users reported bugs with the Virtual Zoo controls screen we have made various fixes.

Apart from that, it is possible now to answer by clicking on images in Instruments and Animals games in case the little players does not know how to read yet.

Hope you enjoy! 

Yours sincerely,
Educational Suite Team.

notes.title: Geometry game has arrived!
notes.content: A new mini-game has been added. What do you know about geometry? Show it by guessing the name of the different geometrical shapes!

notes.title: Performance update
notes.content: Multiple performance improvements has been applied.

notes.title: Check the new virtual zoo!
notes.content: The new virtual zoo has arrived! There you will be able to see how are some animals of the forest, don't miss this wonderful place!

notes.title: Guess the flag game!
notes.content:
A new game has arrived, guess the flag! Do you know about them? can you recognize the country name by its flag? Let's check it!

- Russian language is available from now on!
